title: Cleve Moler has died
summary: This is a news announcement about the death of Cleve Moler, founder of MathWorks and creator of MATLAB, one of the most important numerical computing platforms in scientific and engineering fields.
problem_solved: This marks the passing of a computing pioneer whose MATLAB revolutionized numerical computation and became foundational to engineering and scientific research worldwide.
why_valuable: Cleve Moler's contributions fundamentally changed how engineers and scientists perform numerical analysis, making complex mathematical computations accessible to millions.
